name: Nepal (NBC 105:2020 with the Indian Standards)
description: Nepal's National Building Code (alpha 9 track C21), a pack that extends the built-in pack is-codes. Seismic: NBC 105:2020 (the seismic zoning factor Z of the municipality, 0.25-0.40; soil types A-D with the spectral shape factor Ch(T) of Table 4-1 (Ta, Tc, α, K); the importance factor I = 1.0, 1.25, 1.5; the elastic site spectrum C(T) = Ch(T) Z I; the ULS design spectrum Cd(T) = C(T) / (Rμ Ωu) with the ductility and overstrength factors of Table 5-2; T1 = 1.25 kt H^(3/4); the equivalent static method with α below Ta and k = 1-2; the ULS drift 0.025 with Rμ × the elastic deflections) by the generic shapeFactors spectrum method. Loads: the NBC 105:2020 3.6 combinations (1.2 DL + 1.5 LL, DL + 0.3 LL + E), the wind combinations and IS 875 wind of the parent (NBC 104: Vb 47 m/s), the NBC 103 imposed loads as the parent's IS 875 (Part 2) (NBC 103 follows it). Concrete IS 456:2000 and IS 13920:2016, steel IS 800:2007 and the rest from the parent pack is-codes (NBC 110 not covered: it refers to IS 456). Not covered: the SLS spectrum 0.2 C(T) / Ωs and its drift check (the ULS check governs for the usual factors), the irregularity checks. Every value is listed in VERIFY.md; the municipalities' Z and Ch(T)'s long-period branch are uncertain and must be checked before design.
